info.title: Dataverse Ask
info.description: Dual-purpose Dataverse connector for the Ask APIs. Exposes an MCP endpoint for Copilot Studio agents plus typed operations for Power Automate and Power Apps. A semantic model names the tables that can answer a question, and the Ask operation returns matching rows, a natural-language summary, citation links and a paging token. Part of Business Applications in Work IQ (preview).

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for Copilot Studio integration.

get.description: Lists the semantic models available in this Dataverse environment. Locate a model by its exact unique name or ID rather than by position, because the order of the array is not guaranteed.

parameters.name: include

post.description: Submits a natural-language question against a semantic model and returns the rows that answer it, a natural-language summary and citation links. Results are trimmed to what the caller is authorized to read, so record ownership, business unit access, sharing and column-level security all affect the answer.

query.description: The natural-language question to answer, such as Which open opportunities have the highest estimated revenue?
query.title: Question

semanticModelName.description: The exact unique name of the semantic model to use.
semanticModelName.title: Semantic model name

searchMode.description: The search strategy. Auto lets the service choose, QuickResponse favors a faster answer, and ThinkDeeper favors deeper analysis and takes longer.
searchMode.title: Search mode

count.description: The maximum number of rows to return in this page.
count.title: Row count

pagingToken.description: The paging token from a previous response, passed back unchanged to retrieve the next page. Leave empty for the first page.
pagingToken.title: Paging token

rawResult.description: The rows that answer the question. The properties of each row depend on the question and the query the service generated, so treat these as dynamic JSON objects.
rawResult.title: Rows

items.description: One row of the result. Its properties vary by question.
items.title: Row

citationLinks.description: Links to the Dataverse records behind the answer.
citationLinks.title: Citation links

items.description: A link to a source record.
items.title: Citation link

summary.description: A natural-language summary of the result. May be absent; do not depend on it to process the rows.
summary.title: Summary

totalResultCount.description: The total number of matching rows when available. This value might reflect only the current page.
totalResultCount.title: Total result count

pagingToken.description: An opaque token for the next page. When it is null or empty there are no more pages. Pass it back exactly as returned.
pagingToken.title: Paging token
